profile.swap_desc: Narrow column on the left, content on the right

communities.swap_desc: Narrow column on the left, content on the right
communities.redirect_desc: The «Communities» menu item leads to «My groups», skipping recommendations

photo.title: Photo downloading
photo.desc: Photos at original size, albums as a ZIP archive

clip.title: Clip downloading
clip.desc: A button next to the like

lyrics.page_hint: Drag text or artwork. Esc to finish.
lyrics.title: Lyrics on background
lyrics.description: Synchronized lines and album artwork, independent of the visualizer.
lyrics.availability: Lyrics and accurate timestamps are not available for every track. If LRCLIB has no matching recording, the title and artist are shown.
lyrics.drag_hint: Drag text in the preview, or edit on the page to move text and artwork independently. Click Done to restore normal page interaction.
lyrics.editing: Editing is active on the VK page. Move text or artwork, then click Done or press Esc.
lyrics.open_vk: Open VK, enable Lyrics on background and play a track.
lyrics.no_text: Lyrics are loading or unavailable for this recording.
lyrics.copy_failed: Could not copy. You can save TXT instead.
lyrics.export_hint: TXT contains plain text; LRC contains timestamped lines. LRC is available only when synchronized lyrics are found.

music.upload_master_desc: Several files at once at vk.ru/audios
music.upload_between_desc: At least 2 sec — against Flood control
music.upload_before_desc: At least 0.5 sec — against Too many requests
music.upload_warn_body: No more than 10 tracks at a time — VK may return a Flood control error and temporarily block uploads.

visualizer.title: Music visualizer
visualizer.subtitle: Light and motion synced to VK music
visualizer.nav_desc: Neon spectrum, waves, and particles over your theme
visualizer.hero_desc: Above the wallpaper, below the VK interface
visualizer.drag_hint: Drag the effect to change its position
visualizer.enabled_hint: Play music in VK and the effect will react to the sound. Motion fades smoothly when paused.
visualizer.disabled_hint: Choose a style and enable the visualizer. The preview uses a demo beat.
visualizer.palette_hint: The preview shows a sample palette. On the page, colors come from the image; if it cannot be analyzed, the VKify accent is used.
visualizer.hide_paused: Hide when music is not playing
visualizer.hide_paused_hint: The effect hides when paused or after a track ends, then returns during playback.
visualizer.position_hint: 100% width and height is the effect's original size. Offsets are percentages of the window; you can also drag the preview to reposition it.
visualizer.performance_hint: Animation pauses in hidden tabs and respects the system reduced-motion setting.

lyrics.hint: Lines follow LRCLIB timestamps, matched by artist, title and recording duration. If matching timestamps are unavailable, the title and artist are shown without approximate lyric scrolling.

visualizer.page_hint: Drag the visualizer into position. Press Done or Escape.
visualizer.editing: Position editing is active on the VK page.
visualizer.open_vk: Open a VK tab with the visualizer enabled.

player.autoplay_desc: Resume the track after a page refresh
player.autoplay_permission_desc: Open VK’s site settings in your browser once and set Sound to Allow instead of the default. Then reload VK. Without this permission, the browser may wait for a click before starting music.
player.autoplay_permission_firefox_desc: On VK, click the autoplay blocking icon to the left of the address and select Autoplay → Allow Audio and Video. Firefox will remember this permission for VK. Then reload the page; you will not need to click the player again.

hk.master_desc: The VK player without switching to its tab
hk.anytab_hint: The hotkeys above are local: they only work on the VK tab. To switch tracks from any tab, assign global hotkeys in the browser settings (media keys and Alt+Shift+→/← are usually free).
hk.how_body: Local hotkeys work only on the active VK tab. Speed ranges from 0.25× to 3× in 0.25 steps.

eq.master_desc: 10 frequency bands for the VK player
eq.how_body: Audio is processed right in the browser (Web Audio API). Changes apply instantly — no need to reload the track. An equalizer button also appears in the player on vk.ru.

messages.export_desc: Download the conversation: JSON, TXT, HTML, ZIP, PDF
messages.swap_desc: Conversations on the right, dialog on the left
messages.templates_subtitle: Quick insert into a VK chat via a hotkey or slash

tpl.master_desc: Ready-made replies in the VK chat
tpl.autocomplete_desc: Suggestions while typing. Sometimes gets in the way

toast.max_files: No more than {{max}} files per template

editor.attach_hint: Files will be attached to the message along with the template text. Up to {{max}} files of {{size}} each.

tip.title: How to use it in the VK chat
tip.open_none: enable an opening method above (slash or hotkey)
tip.close_desc: with the same key that opens it:
tip.vars_desc: are substituted automatically from the current chat.
tip.files_desc: from a template are attached to the input box — such templates are not sent automatically, you confirm sending.
